question: Please analyze our interest data from September 2018 to August 2019. For each month, calculate the average composition for each interest by dividing the composition by the index value. Identify the interest with the highest average composition value each month and report its average composition as the max index composition for that month. Compute the three-month rolling average of these monthly max index compositions. Ensure the output includes the date, the interest name, the max index composition for that month, the rolling average, and the names and max index compositions of the top interests from one month ago and two months ago.
sql:
-- Full query with corrected lag logic
WITH monthly_data AS (
    SELECT 
        _year,
        _month,
        month_year,
        interest_id,
        composition / index_value AS avg_composition
    FROM interest_metrics
    WHERE (_year = 2018 AND _month >= 9)
       OR (_year = 2019 AND _month <= 8)
),
monthly_max AS (
    SELECT 
        _year,
        _month,
        month_year,
        interest_id,
        avg_composition,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY _year, _month ORDER BY avg_composition DESC) AS rn
    FROM monthly_data
),
top_per_month AS (
    SELECT 
        _year,
        _month,
        month_year,
        interest_id,
        avg_composition AS max_index_composition
    FROM monthly_max
    WHERE rn = 1
),
with_lags AS (
    SELECT 
        t1._year,
        t1._month,
        t1.month_year,
        t1.interest_id,
        t1.max_index_composition,
        AVG(t1.max_index_composition) OVER (
            ORDER BY t1._year, t1._month 
            ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS rolling_avg_3m,
        t2.interest_id AS prev1_interest_id,
        t2.max_index_composition AS prev1_max_index_composition,
        t3.interest_id AS prev2_interest_id,
        t3.max_index_composition AS prev2_max_index_composition
    FROM top_per_month t1
    LEFT JOIN top_per_month t2 
        ON t2._year = CASE WHEN t1._month = 1 THEN t1._year - 1 ELSE t1._year END
        AND t2._month = CASE WHEN t1._month = 1 THEN 12 ELSE t1._month - 1 END
    LEFT JOIN top_per_month t3 
        ON t3._year = CASE WHEN t1._month <= 2 THEN t1._year - 1 ELSE t1._year END
        AND t3._month = CASE WHEN t1._month = 1 THEN 11 
                              WHEN t1._month = 2 THEN 12 
                              ELSE t1._month - 2 END
)
SELECT 
    w.month_year AS date,
    im1.interest_name,
    ROUND(w.max_index_composition, 4) AS max_index_composition,
    ROUND(w.rolling_avg_3m, 4) AS rolling_avg,
    im2.interest_name AS prev1_interest_name,
    ROUND(w.prev1_max_index_composition, 4) AS prev1_max_index_composition,
    im3.interest_name AS prev2_interest_name,
    ROUND(w.prev2_max_index_composition, 4) AS prev2_max_index_composition
FROM with_lags w
LEFT JOIN interest_map im1 ON im1.id = w.interest_id
LEFT JOIN interest_map im2 ON im2.id = w.prev1_interest_id
LEFT JOIN interest_map im3 ON im3.id = w.prev2_interest_id
ORDER BY w._year, w._month
